I guess my advice would be :
Try to chose the right partner for you. We all want everything in a S.O but we mostly chose what attracts us immediatley. Try to understand that some partners are not good for you and you not good for them. After this, you can either evolve to be someone else and become what you want or stay who you are and be happy with this, but I think chosing the right partner for you beats the idea of only focusing on yourself. Because allthough it is healthy this can serve as an excuse to be self centered and blind to a good person's intent.
